result:
In a world not so different from our own, there existed beings of pure light, called the Luminae. They were beings of pure light, symbiotic to the very essence of the universe as it stood. They knew not the concept of darkness, for they lived in a realm where the light and the darkness were one and the same.

Their home was Sparc, a planet where nothing ever seemed to die, only to start its cycle anew. The Luminae towered over this eternal world of nothing but light, a constant reminder of their eternal existence. They lived in harmony with the planet, never needing to consume or destroy anything, simply basking in the glow of the light that seemed to always fall from the endless sky.

But one day, a flaw in the universe was discovered, a tear in what they had always taken for granted. It was not a hole, as one might imagine, but an absence, a place where the very fabric of reality had torn in two. This rift seemed to open up above Sparc, spewing not darkness, but a substance unknown, something far more dangerous.

The Luminae, initially perplexed, soon discovered that this substance could slowly collapse in on the planet itself. With their way of life on the line, they knew they had to act, to fill the rift with light, to mend the universe.

They began to collect every last Luminae, to act in unison like never before. They split themselves into different forms, moving at speeds they never were capable of before. Their numbers increased exponentially, and yet, in their haste, they discovered a new world outside of their home.

This world was a place of endless night, of darkness that bloomed at the pressure left by the rift. The Luminae began to fill it with their light, not just to mend the universe but to claim their wholly new realm. They saw in this what was to become their greatest frontier.

Luminae reached the edge of the endless night, where darkness seemed to want to climb the last steps in tainting their world. Here, they discovered a being, a creature of neither light nor dark, suspended in the in-between where everything and nothing happened simultaneously. It shared its existence with both the other, revealing the true nature of the rift.

The creature was the being that created the rift, a being ignorant to the true nature of its creation. It had only been trying to patch a hole created from curiosity, not realizing the chaos it may have wrought. The Luminae saw in this being not an adversary, but their key to understanding and repairing the universe.

For centuries, the Luminae worked, merging with the darkness and light, creating new forms, never leaving the planet that raised them. They discovered creatures long lost to the chaos of the rift, some that offered them a new understanding of the universe, its beauty and its destruction in one breath.

As time passed, the rift started to mend, or so it seemed. But then, a few Luminae discovered that the essence of the universe had changed, had shifted in ways that were untraceable to the ways they had always known. The once-united Zeitgeist, the spirit of Sparc, now twisted its light and dark in new, unpredictable ways.

This new equilibrium held for centuries, the Luminae continued to live in harmony with the two worlds that had become their home. But then, as the year turned over into a new era of the cosmos, the cycle repeated, and the Luminae were pushed further than they've ever been.

Motion again displaced the eternal, and the Luminae found themselves once again faced with a choice. To move to the next crisis or to return to their home, the eternal rift that marked their creation. And in that choice, the beginnings of new Empires, new beings, new worlds would be born, in the light, in the dark, and in the depths, in the heights. The universe had become more complex, and the Luminae had grown with it, taking their essence, and the essence of the universe, from which they had once been the only heirs, but now standing as one of the many.
